text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Apparently there's a test-taking strategy
where
you write numbers on a pencil and
give it a roll. If
you ask me, that's pure
nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You can't leave everything up to fate.
It's not a
real bet unless you really throw
yourself into it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I'd bet on what kinda
questions are
gonna show up—then
study nothing else!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You can't think about what happens if
you guess
wrong. Can't get fired up
without a little risk, am I
right?
